title: Ask Again When It's Wrong
goal: If the answer is wrong, say WHAT was wrong.
mascot_lines: If your first question doesn't get a great answer, that's okay.
Asking again with different words is not giving up — it's how we get unstuck.
Add a little more info or change the angle, and the helper often figures it out.
Two tries beat one almost every time.

tier2.rephrase: Pick the answer that tells the robot WHAT to fix.

tier3.nudge: Vague: 'wrong'. Better: 'too big, make it small'.
